title: Split conformal on the adapted score + the joint operating-point frontier

conformal.note: empirical coverage is over held-out factories; q is the ceil((n_cal+1)*alpha) order statistic of the calibration conformity scores. review share = non-singleton rate.

verdict: best adapted operating point at review<=60%: adapted(b) asymmetric accept=0.25 reject=0.15 -> review 60.0% BA 0.8571 CI [0.746, 0.939]; frozen reference rank-avg w=0.16: review 44.2% BA 0.7076 CI [0.5207, 0.8317]. 3 adapted points have BOTH lower review and higher BA than the frozen reference (dominance); the adapted quantile frontier is uniformly above the frozen one because its OOD AUROC is 0.781 vs 0.566.
